profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Embedded systems design with a focus on cybersecurity in space payloads group.

positions.title: Engineering Leadership Program
positions.description: Rotational program through software, hardware, and systems engineering roles. Major accomplishments include proposal, design, and implementation of an automated quantum key distribution testbench; full implementation of trusted boot on Xilinx FPGA in an IRAD group.

positions.title: Information Security Intern
positions.description: Worked as a part of the engineering information security team on data processing, networking, and security applications.

positions.title: FPGA Design Intern
positions.description: Worked on FPGA design and test for radar systems.

positions.title: Junior Computer Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked as a government contractor doing networking and cybersecurity applications.

positions.title: Robotics and Machine Systems Lab Intern
positions.description:
Developed software and hardware to integrate encoders into design of inspection robot. 3-D    
printed parts necessary to integrate hall effect encoders onto design. Wrote software to run     
motors and encoders through Atmel AVR. Wrote software on Intel Edison to control multiple 
AVR’s through I2C bus. Wired all relevant electrical components together.

positions.title: Lifeguard
positions.description: Monitored pool patrons to ensure safety and prevent accidents. Taught swim lessons. Administered first aid. Maintained order in the pool area by completing maintenance duties as well as monitoring the chemical levels of the pool.
